noWallet.body: Walat ta Cardano tana ba ku damar ajiye ADA (kuɗin Cardano) da kuma biyan ƙaramin kuɗi don wallafa ƙuduri. Masu kaɗa ƙuri'a ba sa buƙatarta ko kaɗan — masu ƙirƙirar ƙudurori kaɗai ke buƙatarta.
noWallet.step1: Ku sauke <bold>Vespr</bold> — ita ce walat ɗin Cardano mafi sauƙi ga sababbi, an yi ta don waya.
noWallet.step2: Ku ƙirƙiri walat ɗinku sannan ku rubuta kalmomin dawo da ita (recovery phrase) ku ajiye su a wuri mai aminci.
noWallet.linkErrorMessage: Ku nemi "Vespr Wallet" a Play Store.
noWallet.linkErrorTitle: Ba a iya buɗe mahaɗin ba

verifyErrors.malformed_hash: Wannan ba lambar mu'amala ba ce. Ya kamata ta kasance haruffa da lambobi 64. Ku sake kwafa ta daga walat ɗinku.

payment.step2: Aika kuɗin daga walat ɗinku na Cardano
payment.prefillNote: Vespr na cike muku adireshin da adadin kuɗin. A wasu walat, ku liƙa adireshin da adadin da kuka kwafa a mataki na 1.
payment.ownWalletNote: Ku aika daga walat ɗinku na kanku, ba daga kasuwar canjin kuɗi ba. Adireshin da kuka biya daga gare shi zai bayyana a matsayin wanda ya gabatar da ƙudurin.
payment.openWalletFailedTitle: Ba a sami manhajar walat ba
payment.openWalletFailedMessage: Ku buɗe walat ɗinku na Cardano da kanku, sannan ku aika kuɗin zuwa adireshin da ke sama.
payment.step3: Kwafi lambar mu'amala sannan ku dawo nan
payment.step3Helper: Walat ɗinku yana nuna ta a cikin bayanan biyan kuɗin, wani lokaci da sunan "Tx hash". Idan kun dawo, VoteBoxApp zai same ta a allon kwafi.
